entry.title: substrate
entry.summary:
## The Problem Running many autonomous agents on shared Kubernetes clusters requires isolation that standard containers cannot provide. Agents are idle most of the time, so containers waste memory, and untrusted code can access credentials if a pod is compromised. A runtime that can snapshot idle agents and resume them quickly while keeping each agent in its own micro‑VM is needed.
